Siege win needs the zone camp count at zero and its slot time passed; each camp kill lowers the count, and each win feeds a shared total that starts milestone events at 50, 100 and 150 wins.

Roaming world boss (emerald dragon scripts): wanders 25 yd when no threat, follows a random threat player for 15 to 30 s without attacking, and pulls its current victim back when it is past 50 yd (checked every 0.5 s).
Wintergrasp war clock: 30 min battle, 150 min quiet, invite window 15 min before a battle, battle skipped above 3500 sessions, and taking all three south towers cuts 10 min off the battle clock.
Capture meter: each second moves the value by the head-count difference, clamped by a max step; Grizzly Hills flips stop one defence event and start the new owner's.
Idle cadence: Herald's first line within 5 s then random gaps from 150 ms to 1 h; siege minions wander 1 yd from their camp; Pallid Horror yells every 65 to 300 s.
